title: From Procedural Skills to Strategy Genes: Towards Experience-Driven Test-Time Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2604.15097v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This beta technical report asks how reusable experience should be represented so that it can function as effective test-time control and as a substrate for iterative evolution. We study this question in 4.590 controlled trials across 45 scientific code-solving scenarios. We find that documentation-oriented Skill packages provide unstable control: their useful signal is sparse, and expanding a compact experience object into a fuller documentation package often fails to help and can degrade the overall average. We further show that representation itself is a first-order factor. A compact Gene representation yields the strongest overall average, remains competitive under substantial structural perturbations, and outperforms matched-budget Skill fragments, while reattaching documentation-oriented material usually weakens rather than improves it. translated_title: 从程序化技能到策略基因：迈向经验驱动的测试时演化
translated_abstract: 本贝塔版技术报告探讨了一个问题：可复用的经验应当如何表示，才能既作为有效的测试时控制手段，又作为迭代演化的基础。我们在45个科学代码求解场景中开展了4590次受控试验来研究这一问题。我们发现，面向文档的技能包所提供的控制并不稳定：其有效信号稀疏，而将一个紧凑的经验对象扩展为更完整的文档化包往往无济于事，甚至会降低整体平均表现。我们进一步证明，表示方式本身就是一阶关键因素：紧凑的基因表示能够取得最强的整体平均成绩，在显著的结构扰动下仍保持竞争力，并优于同等预算的技能片段，而重新附加面向文档的材料通常会削弱而非改善其表现。除一次性控制之外，我们还表明基因也是迭代式经验演化的更优载体。
tldr: 本研究通过45个场景、4590次受控试验发现，紧凑的“策略基因”表示比面向文档的技能包更适合作为可复用经验的载体，在测试时控制与迭代演化中均表现更优，证明经验的表示方式本身是决定性因素。
en_tdlr: Through 4,590 controlled trials across 45 scientific code-solving scenarios, this study demonstrates that a compact "Gene" representation outperforms documentation-oriented Skill packages as a carrier of reusable experience for both test-time control and iterative evolution, showing that representation itself is a first-order factor.
